subject: math
question: 设函数列 $\sin_1 x = \sin x, \sin_n x = \sin (\sin_{n-1} x), n = 2,3,\cdots$ . 证明 $\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt{\frac{n}{3}} \sin_n x = 1$ .

steps.text: 分析 只需证明 $\lim_{n\to \infty}n\sin_n^2 x = 3$ ，显然 $\sin_n^2 x$ 单调递减并趋于0，故可考虑对 $\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{n}{1 / \sin_n^2x}$ 用施笃兹定理.
对取定的 $x$ ，显然 $\sin_n^2 x$ 单调递减并趋于 0，利用施笃兹定理，有

\begin{array}{r l} \lim _ {n \to \infty} n \sin_ {n} ^ {2} x & = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \frac {n}{\frac {1}{\sin_ {n} ^ {2} x}} = \lim _ {n \to \infty} \frac {(n + 1) - n}{\frac {1}{\sin_ {n + 1} ^ {2} x} - \frac {1}{\sin_ {n} ^ {2} x}} \\ & = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {1}{\frac {1}{\sin^ {2} t} - \frac {1}{t ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {t ^ {2} \sin^ {2} t}{t ^ {2} - \sin^ {2} t} = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {t ^ {4}}{t ^ {2} - \sin^ {2} t} \\ & = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {4 t ^ {3}}{2 t - \sin 2 t} = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {1 2 t ^ {2}}{2 - 2 \cos 2 t} = 3. \end{array}
